SELECT , tu.real_name AS teacherName, su.real_name AS studentName FROM volunteer_record vr LEFT JOIN user tu ON vr.teacher_id = tu.id LEFT JOIN user su ON vr.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN teacher_profile t ON vr.teacher_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN student_profile s ON vr.student_id = s.user_id
AND s.school_id = #{schoolId}
AND vr.status = 1
ORDER BY vr.create_time DESC
